```{python}
#| label: cargar-corpus
from pathlib import Path
import sys

ROOT = Path.cwd().parent if Path.cwd().name == "docs" else Path.cwd()
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "docs" / "study"))
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "scripts"))
import render_helpers as rh
from report_helpers import kpis

idx = rh.corpus_index(); caps = rh.corpus_captions(); titles = rh.corpus_titles()
kpis([
    (str(len(idx["article_figures"]) + len(idx["figures"])), "Plates in this chapter"),
    (str(len(idx["article_tables"]) + len(idx["tables"])), "Supporting tables, each opening to its full contents"),
    ("18", "Pipeline modules that produced them"),
])
```

This chapter holds the complete set of plates and supporting tables the analysis pipeline produced —
the material the earlier chapters summarise. Every plate appears with its caption and every table
unfolds to its full contents, so nothing the study computed is left out of this report. The order and
the thematic grouping are those of the pipeline's own extended-material index.

The series here use the case definition of the main analysis, **F84 without Rett syndrome (F84.2)**; the
sensitivity that includes Rett appears among the plates below and again in the supplementary figures of
[Results](results.qmd). All counts are administrative recognition, not prevalence or incidence.

::: {.callout-note}
## Why most plates here are images rather than code

In [Results](results.qmd) every figure is drawn by the code printed beneath it. Most of the plates in
this chapter are stored images instead. The pipeline that drew them (`study/pipeline/00_provenance.py`
to `17_extended_material.py`) is versioned in this repository, but it reads the hospital and community
**microdata**, which is not — so that code cannot run from a clone. Where a plate's underlying series
survives in a published table, it is redrawn here from that table with its code shown; where it does
not, the stored image is shown and says so. Every table in this chapter is data you can read and reuse.
:::

## Principal plates

```{python}
#| label: corpus-laminas-articulo
#| output: asis
for it in idx["article_figures"]:
    stem = it["file"].replace(".png", "")
    meta = rh.corpus_lookup(stem, caps["main"], caps["extra"], it["id"], it["desc"])
    print(rh.corpus_figure_md(stem, meta) + "\n")
```

## Supplementary plates

```{python}
#| label: corpus-laminas-suplementarias
#| output: asis
group = None
for it in idx["figures"]:
    if it["group"] != group:
        group = it["group"]; print(f"\n### {group}\n")
    stem = it["file"].replace(".png", "")
    meta = rh.corpus_lookup(stem, caps["main"], caps["extra"], it["id"], it["desc"])
    print(f"**{it['id']}** (`{it['file']}`, origin: {it['origin']})\n")
    print(rh.corpus_figure_md(stem, meta) + "\n")
```

## Principal tables

```{python}
#| label: corpus-tablas-articulo
#| output: asis
for it in idx["article_tables"]:
    stem = it["file"].replace(".csv", "")
    meta = rh.corpus_lookup(stem, titles["main"], titles["extra"], it["id"], it["desc"])
    print(rh.corpus_table_html(stem, meta) + "\n")
```

## Supplementary tables

```{python}
#| label: corpus-tablas-suplementarias
#| output: asis
group = None
for it in idx["tables"]:
    if it["group"] != group:
        group = it["group"]; print(f"\n### {group}\n")
    stem = it["file"].replace(".csv", "")
    meta = rh.corpus_lookup(stem, titles["main"], titles["extra"], it["id"], it["desc"])
    meta = dict(meta); meta["title"] = f"{it['id']}. " + meta["title"] if not meta["title"].startswith(it["id"]) else meta["title"]
    print(rh.corpus_table_html(stem, meta) + "\n")
```
